to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

 Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions —20
Implementation of CAS in Metro
cities
*241. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that recently, a
final decision has been taken to implement
the Conditional Access System in Delhi,
Kolkata and Mumbai;
(b) if so, the details of the plan drawn
up, including arrangements made for
supply of Set Top Boxes, and the present
status of its implementation; and
(c) the steps taken to launch any
awareness campaign on the benefits of the
CAS available to the consumers?
Discrimination against Indians in
British jails
†*242. MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that 253 Indians languishing in the
British jails have been deported from
England;
(b) whether these Indians have been
charged with involvement in criminal cases;
(c) whether Indians put in open jails are
being discriminated against as they are not
of British origin; and
(d) whether Government have objected
to this discrimination against these Indians
in jail?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

75
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Installation of mobile BTS at
Azamgarh
*243. SHRI GANDHI AZAD: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of mobile Base
Transmitting Station (BTS) that are
proposed to be installed in Azamgarh
District;
(b) the names of places where land has
been allotted for this purpose in Azamgarh
District;
(c) whether mobile BTS at Jainagar in
Azamgarh District is under construction;
(d) if so, the details of progress made in
this regard; and
(e) by when this mobile BTS at Jainagar
will be completed?
Clearance to the pending projects in
Rajasthan
†*244. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
SHIPPING, ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any difference in
the annual allocation deposit amount by
Rajasthan for the year 2006-07 and the
amount released till last year in the Central
Road Fund; if so, the reasons therefor; and
(b) by when the 33 works amounting to
Rs. 55.76 crores presented on 6th May,
2006 by the Government of Rajasthan,
would be sanctioned?
Identity of a person for sting
operation
†*245. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: Will the Minister of
INFORMATION AND BROADCASTING
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Committee constituted by Government has
suggested the establishment of identity of
a person mandatory before making him the
target of a sting operation;
(b) if so, whether on the basis of said
suggestion Government have given direction
to the private companies of electronic
media; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
CVC guidelines for organisations
*246. SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is mandatory for the
organizations under the purview of Central
Vigilance Commission to publish every
month the summary of contracts/purchases
made above a threshold value on their
website;
(b) whether most of such organizations
are not displaying every month the
summary of contracts/purchases made by
them above a threshold value on their
website;
(c) if so, what action does the Central
Vigilance Commission propose to take in
the matter; and
(d) the details of the threshold value of
each organization?

76
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Entrance of US based telephone
company in India
*247. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that "Vonage" the
US brand telephone company is planning
to enter into India by which calling to
Canada could become free and US or UK at
local rates;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) Government's reaction thereto and
the steps taken in this regard?
Spectrum allotment
*248. SHRI PRAVEEN RASHTRAPAL:
Will the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Wireless Planning and
Coordination Cell have issued a circular for
allotment of 5th and 6th criteria based on
subscriber numbers;
(b) whether it is a fact that subscriber-
based allotment of spectrum is followed
only in India and is not based on international
norms;
(c) whether it is also a fact that mobile
operators are o

Safety of nuclear materials
1639. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
encourage private participation, including
from abroad, in the country's ambitious
nuclear power programme, to generate
20,000 mw of power by 2020;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the safeguards that are proposed to
be worked out to secure safety of nuclear
materials in private hands?
Allocation of captive
coal blocks
1640. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA: Will the Minister of COAL be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Centre and States are
divided on revision of royalty on coal that
is unchanged since August, 2002;
(b) whether Prime Minister at a meeting
directed Coal Ministry to review screening
criteria in awarding coal blocks for speedy
allocation of captive coal blocks and
suggested preference be given to power
generating companies;
(c) whether it was decided that Coal
Ministry would submit report of de-
reservation of coal blocks reserved
exclusively for CIL to Prime Minister;
(d) whether any interim report has been
submitted; and
(e) if so, whether any final decision has
been taken?

379
Amendment of MMDR Act and
MC Rules
1641. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are of the view
to amend Mines and Minerals Development
and Regulation Act, 1957 and Mineral
Concession Rules, 1960 for speedy and time
bound development of mineral resources
available in the State of Rajasthan and
Karnataka;
(b) whether Government are considering
to strengthen State Government by providing
more powers by deleting part 'A' and part
'C' of Schedule-I of MMDR Act; and
(c) if so, by when and if not, the reasons
therefor?
Coal reserves in
Orissa
†1642. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 61 billion
tonnes of coal reserves have still been
estimated in the State of Orissa;
(b) if so, the facts in this regard;
(c) whether quality of the said coal has
also been estimated; and
(d) if so, the details regarding the
category as well as the quantity of the said
coal?
Royalty on coal for Chhattisgarh
†1643. SHRI NARAYAN SINGH
KESARI:
 SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the State of Chhattisgarh
has requested for fixing royalty on coal on
market-rate basis;
(b) whether the rate of royalty should
have been revised by now;
(c) if so, whether the demand of the
State for fixing 25 per cent royalty on
market-rate basis has been accepted; and
(d) whether coal producing States have
their representation in Committee which
fixes the royalty; if not, the reasons
therefor?
CIL proposal for hospital in Kolkata
1644. SHRI PRASANTA CHATTER-
JEE: Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether any approval by Coal India
Limited was given in 2004 for construction
of AIIMS type hospital in Kolkata;
(b) the total expenditure incurred by
Coal India Limited for advertisements in
papers and hoardings;
(c) the amount spent as dole/compensation
for land and names of the beneficiaries; and
(d) the present status of this project?
Money wasted for image building by
CIL
1645. SHRIMATI JAYA BACHCHAN:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Coal India
Ltd. has been burning public money on an
image making exercise;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

(b) whether it is also a fact that it has
been giving largesse to a private club in
Kolkata and has also spent Rs. 10 lacs on a
PR exercise; and
(c) the action Government have taken
to curb the expenditure?
Lignite resources in Cauvery belt of
Tamil Nadu
1646. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN: Will
the Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether coal mining activities are
already under operation in Jayam Kondam
Cholapuram and some other places in the
Cauvery belt of Tamil Nadu for lignite
production;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, Government's plan for mining
the lignite resources found in those areas
and by when?
